name: Sikasso

queries.query: Sikasso Mali official cadastral map parcel land registry GIS cadastre
queries.result: The first-party Direction Générale des Domaines et du Cadastre (DGDC/DNDC) portal and its regional-services page were found. The current public cadastre API catalog exposes six layers, all bounded to Bamako/Kati, and no Sikasso layer or Sikasso parcel geometry was verified.

queries.query: Sikasso Mali cadastre carte parcellaire registre foncier service officiel
queries.result: Les sources officielles DGDC/DNDC documentent le cadastre communal et listent une DRDC/Sikasso. Une annonce officielle de la DGI indique que le projet NINACAD-ADRESSE couvre Sikasso, mais aucun accès public anonyme à une couche de parcelles de Sikasso n'a été vérifié dans cette tentative.

officialEvidence.observation: The official DGDC regional-services page lists DRDC/SIKASSO and phone 21 62 17 51.
officialEvidence.coverage: Local/regional DGDC custody is evidenced; this page is not a parcel data feed.

officialEvidence.observation: The official DGDC cadastre page states that cadastral records are organized at communal, local, regional and national levels and that each parcel receives a unique NINACAD identifier.
officialEvidence.coverage: Mali national cadastral mandate and data model; not proof of open Sikasso coverage.

officialEvidence.observation: The official DGI article says the NINACAD-ADRESSE project covers Sikasso among the cities in its then-current phase.
officialEvidence.coverage: Project coverage claim for Sikasso; no public parcel geometry endpoint was provided.

observedServices.observation: Anonymous official portal loaded and exposed current JavaScript configuration dgdcPortail.apiUrl=https://dndc.gouv.ml/wp-json/dgdc/v1.

Current public JavaScript references GET cadastre layer metadata, parcels/{parcel_id}, and GeoJSON routes. It uses safe parcel fields for the public parcel form, but no Sikasso-specific layer was referenced.
Anonymous REST route discovery returned cadastre/layers, layer metadata, parcels/{parcel_id}, and GeoJSON routes.

Returned six published layers: aci2000, aci2000v1, aci2000v3, medina-coura, couche-007 (parcelles_kati_2024), and recette-commune-iv. Their reported bounds are in Bamako/Kati; no Sikasso layer appeared.
Metadata returned featureCount 2994, bounds [-8.038598563,12.618790098,-8.012116044,12.64273048], and no explicit CRS field.

Bounded request using the unchanged WUP Sikasso vicinity returned an empty FeatureCollection for the Bamako-bounded aci2000 layer. This is a layer/extent observation only and is not evidence of citywide absence.

A bounded anonymous sample from an existing non-Sikasso layer returned GeoJSON MultiPolygon with native id/parcelleId and parcel metadata. Native schema was inspected in ignored scratch only; no foreign geometry or source attributes were retained.
Endpoint responded that a parcel number is required; no broad parcel listing was attempted.

research.crs: Not explicitly supplied by the GeoJSON response; coordinate order observed as [longitude, latitude] in the non-Sikasso sample.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: DGDC/DNDC national cadastre with regional/local custody; official page lists DRDC/Sikasso and DGI describes NINACAD-ADRESSE project coverage including Sikasso.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local custody and national API routes were verified, but the live public layer catalog exposed only Bamako/Kati layers and no Sikasso parcel feature layer.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Local/regional DGDC Sikasso custody is evidenced; public citywide parcel accessibility and completeness are not established.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no Sikasso native parcel identity retained
attributesRequested: safe parcel identity and geometry only

blocker: The current anonymous DGDC cadastre catalog contains no Sikasso layer. The API's non-Sikasso sample demonstrates a parcel identity/geometry schema, but cannot be used as Sikasso evidence.
remainingUncertainty: Sikasso cadastral records may exist in unpublished, offline, authenticated, or future NINACAD layers. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; the bounded empty response does not support a citywide absence claim.
nextStep: If a later attempt is authorized, recheck the first-party DGDC catalog and any explicitly public Sikasso/NINACAD layer; retain no geometry unless a bounded Sikasso response provides a stable native parcel identity and polygon.
